1. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests and data records from a plurality of creditors to file bankruptcy documents with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein the bankruptcy documents are specifically formatted proofs of claim documents for filing with bankruptcy courts;
automatically generating the bankruptcy documents with the received data records by formatting the data records according to specific filing requirements of each bankruptcy organization, wherein the bankruptcy documents are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the bankruptcy documents with the different bankruptcy organizations.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different courts with different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming the received data records into court-specific proof of claim formats.

6. (Currently Amended) A method comprising:
receiving requests from a plurality of creditors to file proofs of claims for debts owed by debtors to the creditors with a plurality of different bankruptcy organizations, wherein each request includes a data record for generating a proof of claim that includes creditor-specific claim information and supporting documentation;
automatically generating the proofs of claims with the received data records by formatting each proof of claim according to the specific filing requirements and formats of each bankruptcy organization, wherein the proofs of claims are suitable for filing with different bankruptcy organizations; and
batch filing the proofs of claims with the different bankruptcy organizations.

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein the different bankruptcy organizations are different bankruptcy courts having different filing system configurations, and wherein the automatically generating step includes transforming the data records into court-specific proof of claim formats.

8. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising sending bankruptcy notification messages to the plurality of creditors, wherein the bankruptcy notification messages notify the creditors of the filing status of their specific proofs of claims and that various debtors have filed for bankruptcy.

9. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests from the plurality of creditors comprises receiving the requests using a secure file transfer protocol and validating the data records prior to generating the proofs of claims.

10. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein receiving requests comprises receiving requests via a Web site with user authentication.

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 where batch filing comprises aggregating the proofs of claims and filing the proofs of claims in a batch mode at least once per day, wherein each proof of claim is formatted according to the specific requirements of the receiving bankruptcy organization.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising:
generating a report specific to each creditor showing the status of their filed proofs of claims; and
sending the report to a particular creditor.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises enabling a user to request the report using a Web site with secure access.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein generating the report comprises generating an aging report specifying a reason some proofs of claims have not been filed and the specific bankruptcy organization filing requirements that caused delays.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 further comprising receiving a filing receipt for a filed proof of claim from the bankruptcy organization.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 wherein batch filing is performed by a server computer that formats each proof of claim according to the specific filing system configuration of each bankruptcy organization.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 6 further comprising validating the data record against the specific filing requirements of each bankruptcy organization prior to generating the proof of claim.
